evidence: current spelling's disassembly matches the image's original (0x0062AB10) instruction-for-instruction outside offsets 0x1A-0x30: identical prologue loads interleaved with push esi/push edi, identical four rect stores to [ecx+0x58c/0x590/0x594/0x598], identical reload sequence and call/pops/ret; the sole divergence is add edi,edx/add esi,eax hoisted above the stores where the image has add edx,edi/add eax,esi between the store pairs

the image's store-then-add order is forced by a WAR hazard on edx/eax exactly when the adds destroy those registers, so the placement is a consequence of the destination choice - a single VC6 allocation decision, consistent with the same class of residual documented for UNK3 and decode_byte_run_trans
payload.hypothesis: The fill-family block's byte target decomposes into exactly two independent mechanisms - the load/reload sequence, which the current pointer-store spelling already reproduces exactly, and the add destination/placement pair, which is compiler-internal - so any future spelling search should evaluate candidates by whether they change the add destination registers at all, not by byte-diff totals, since every measured shape either matches the prologue and hoists or anchors and permutes.
